description:
The file SSH bootstrap writes on a node before the agent first starts (mode 0600).

The enrollment token is single-use and short-lived; once enrolled, the agent
rewrites this file with `enrollment_token` and `token_expires_at` set to null.
A file that carries a token asks for a fresh enrollment (a new node key), so
SSH bootstrap re-enrolls a node by writing a new token. `ca_sha256` pins the
fleet's internal CA: the agent accepts only certificates chaining to that CA.

ca_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the internal CA certificate (DER).
ca_sha256.title: Ca Sha256

fleet_id.description: Fleet identifier: a lowercase UUID fixed when the fleet is created.
fleet_id.title: Fleet Id

node_id.description: Node identifier: the server's lowercase topology ID, unique within the fleet.
node_id.title: Node Id

service_url.description: Base URL of the control service: scheme, host, and secret path, without a trailing slash.
service_url.title: Service Url

tls_pin_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the service's TLS public key (SPKI) when 443 serves a self-signed certificate.
tls_pin_sha256.title: Tls Pin Sha256

anyOf.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC, ending in Z.

token_expires_at.description: When the token expires; `null` once enrolled.
token_expires_at.title: Token Expires At

title: AgentBootstrap
